recent_en: ISF Group secured RM83.2mil in data centre-related contracts in November 2026, lifting its order book to RM225.5mil. Earlier, in September 2026, several directors and a substantial shareholder reported disposals of indirect interests.
notable_en: Secured RM83.2mil in data centre-related contracts, raising order book to RM225.5mil.
Directors and a substantial shareholder indirectly disposed a total of 25,900,000 ordinary shares (2.590%) on 23 September 2026.
risks_en: Several directors and a substantial shareholder indirectly disposed shares in September 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM31.385mil, up 19.9% QoQ; net income was RM8.168mil, up 89.2% QoQ; net margin rose from 16.5% to 26.0%.
